payload.claim: The new `_rebut_gates` docstring says "each surviving adequacy probe is asked again", but the code two lines below filters `blockers` only on `f.probe is not None and f.probe_verdict == "survived"`, with no lens check. Per the spec's own Out of scope note ("Criterion-probe and wrong-version survivors ... step 1 takes them"), a criterion-probe or wrong-version survivor is also swept into this re-ask, so the docstring's narrowing to "adequacy probe" misdescribes what the code actually selects.
